compiled_state.title: As a DSO contributor, I want a capability spike validating @google/design.md CLI semantics, so that enforcement stories build on verified assumptions.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Time-boxed capability spike that validates @google/design.md CLI behavior before enforcement stories begin.
**Why**: Stories 1-8 depend on verified assumptions about exit-code semantics, latency, and diff-scoping. A spike-first approach prevents building on unvalidated assumptions.
**Scope**:
- IN: Pinned version selection, exit-code mapping, cold-start/warm-cache latency measurement, diff-touched-line scoping under auto-formatters
- OUT: Lint wrapper implementation, config gate, pre-commit hook wiring (those are draft-2)

## Done Definitions

- plugins/dso/docs/spikes/design-md-cli-validation.md exists with a heading recording the pinned @google/design.md version and the exit-code mapping for pass, fail, and error conditions ← Satisfies: sc-7 (sc-7: "Capability spike completed and recorded before any enforcement story ships")
- The spike report includes cold-start and warm-cache wall-clock latency measurements taken on at least one network environment without a warm npm cache ← Satisfies: sc-7
- The spike report documents the diff-touched-line scoping behavior observed under at least one whitespace-normalizing IDE auto-formatter (e.g., Prettier) ← Satisfies: sc-7
- The spike report is committed and reviewable before any enforcement story begins implementation ← Satisfies: sc-7
  ← Validates Closure Check: "The file plugins/dso/docs/spikes/design-md-cli-validation.md exists and contains a heading recording the pinned @google/design.md version and the exit-code mapping."
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Latency] Cold-start latency for npx --yes may be network-dependent; record the environment (home network, CI runner, etc.) alongside the measurement.
- [Scoping] If @google/design.md does not natively support diff-only scoping, document the gap and the workaround strategy for the lint wrapper.
- [Time-box] If the spike exceeds 1 day, record partial findings and escalate unresolved questions as blockers for downstream stories.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
